cs.t: Yeah. I associate Dyson with having my face sprayed with a mist of other people's dirty water while my ears suffer a blast like a jet engine. Generally I wipe my hands on my clothes or shake them around instead.
cs.th: James Dyson Sold Us on a $400 Hair Dryer. Now He's Trying a $499 Toothbrush

cs.t: My main grievance with Dyson dryers it that it's difficult keeping your hands in the little narrow gap while the jet is blasting your hands, without touching the sides. It kind of defeats the point if you end up touching the dryer. It seems like a case of form over function.
cs.th: Using a Dyson hand dryer is like setting off a viral bomb in a bathroom
